title: Borssele Nuclear Power Station

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation immediately west of the mapped dome.

mapIdentity.provider: Named Borssele exterior perimeter from Dutch building register via OpenStreetMap
mapIdentity.scope: The named Dutch building-register outline mapped in OpenStreetMap controls placement, the curved base of the visible dome and the general public exterior roofline. Smaller exterior masses are generalized.

note: EPZ identifies the familiar concrete dome as the station’s exterior landmark. The building map records a 50 m overall height. Wall colors, roof transitions, window bands and surface details are medium-fi estimates.
